short_description: Adobe Commerce and Magento's REST API cart-item custom-options upload path writes attacker-supplied files to pub/media/custom_options/quote/ without option ID validation, option type gating or extension restrictions, so unauthenticated attackers upload polyglot files (PHP code disguised as images) via the guest-cart routes (CVE-2026-48356, tracked as PolyShell); all versions since the first Magento 2 release up to 2.4.9-alpha2 are affected, fixed in 2.4.9 final and backported to supported lines via APSB26-73, and it is exploited in mass.
title: Adobe Commerce and Magento PolyShell unrestricted file upload (CVE-2026-48356)
